facility: Winchester Water Treatment Plant, Roseburg, Oregon
source: City of Roseburg, Water Treatment Facilities Preliminary Design Report, July 2009 (public record)
question: Can the Winchester Water Treatment Plant be expanded from its current 12 mgd to 18 mgd? For each unit along the flow path, determine whether it limits 18 mgd, the flow at which it becomes limiting, and the least-cost modification that makes 18 mgd work.

criteria.name: Current plant nominal treatment rating
criteria.value: 12 mgd single flocculation/sedimentation basin rated at 12 mgd

criteria.name: Expansion target flow for this study
criteria.value: 18 mgd expanded plant capacity with two additional filters (Filters 5 and 6)

criteria.name: Drawing ultimate design flow
criteria.value: 22 MGD ultimate plant flow note on WINCHESTER WTP HYDRAULIC PROFILE

criteria.name: Ultimate overflow / planning flow
criteria.value: 24 mgd combined clearwell overflows can accommodate ultimate plant flow

criteria.name: Firm capacity definition
criteria.value: Firm capacity = capacity with largest unit out of service; e.g. high service firm nominally 10 mgd, wastewater firm 3000 gpm with one pump out

criteria.name: Desirable clearwell detention
criteria.value: ~60 minutes detention at peak flow; currently met at 12 mgd only if entire clearwell volume available; 57 min at 18 mgd with Filters 5-6

criteria.name: Desirable transmission main velocity
criteria.value: ~6.0 fps maximum desirable velocity in finished water main; short on-site segment allows higher as acceptable; 6.0 fps exceeded at ~18 mgd

criteria.name: Surge protection rating
criteria.value: Surge protection provided for pumping rates up to 9700 gpm (14.0 mgd); upsurge to 150 psi, downsurge to HGL 630 ft

criteria.name: Clearwell overflow rating
criteria.value: HSPS weir El.449.5 ft x 9 ft ~19 mgd at 1 ft depth; Filter No.3 weir El.450.00 ft x 15 ft; combined 24 mgd; normal operation 8-10 ft depth, 3 to 1 ft below overflow

criteria.name: Filter normal operating level
criteria.value: 463 to 464 ft controlled by effluent flow control; 5 to 6 ft submergence over media

criteria.name: Filter-to-waste demonstrated capacity
criteria.value: ~2 mgd does not appear to convey more than 2 mgd; difference vs filter design flow causes flow surge on other filters

criteria.name: Demonstrated pretreatment performance
criteria.value: Excellent pretreatment at sustained flows up to 11.5 mgd warm low-turbidity; normal cold high-turbidity 3.5-5.0 mgd

criteria.name: Plant operating range observed
criteria.value: 3.5 mgd low demand to 11.6 mgd recent peak summer day, operated 24/7 to keep Reservoir Hill terminal reservoirs full

rfi.issue: Clearwell usable volume vs CT volume conflict; baffling, contact time, operating band at 18 mgd unknown (Section 3 not provided)

issues.evidence: rerun HSPS-EXIST: pumps at 119% of rated flow, TDH 263.8 ft vs rated 305 ft (p.115); spec reservoirs CLEARWELL 448.0 ft to HILL 710.0 ft (dwg p.136) via 500 ft of 29.25-in pipe (p.116) only. p.117-p.118 off-site 20-in +30-in, 9400 ft parallel, 27-in/24-in reach omitted. firm_capacity HSPS-EXIST 11.984 mgd, HSPS-6PUMP 21.43 mgd.

issues.evidence: Logged runs list includes HSPS-5PUMP (firm 16.729 mgd claimed) and RAW-SCREEN, WTP-GRAV-BASE, WTP-GRAV-22; reruns performed only on HSPS-EXIST, HSPS-6PUMP, WTP-PROF-CAL, WTP-PROF-2BASIN. No logged cost_estimate labels for $3.42M basin, $3.22M filters, $129k surge, $40k pump.

issues.issue: Filter-effluent pipe velocity/headloss not evaluated as limit; control element forces zero residual at filters (464.0 ft) and hides loading. 8.9-10.8 fps exceeds desirable transmission velocity 6.0 fps (p.116) and was not flagged or put on element as limit.

issues.issue: Single-weir rating 19 mgd (p.114) leaves 1 mgd margin at 18 mgd target; study marks overflows non-limiting without modeling chamber/outfall or requiring both weirs. Thin margin + unmodeled outfall = weak non-limit finding.

issues.evidence: p.113: waste ~2 mgd, >3.4 mgd through remaining filters at 9.1 mgd; p.113 reconfig beyond 18 mgd. Capacity table marks waste binds at ~2 mgd but limits_target false for 18 mgd.
issues.issue: At 9.1 mgd plant flow waste already surges others to >3.4 mgd each; at 18 mgd per-filter waste need is 3.0-4.5 mgd (ASSUMPTION allocation). Claiming meter/sample fix suffices to 18 mgd without Test T-06 is unsupported; N-1 filter loading interaction missed.

issues.evidence: rerun HSPS-6PUMP: ONSITE30 velocity 8.65 fps at all-pumps 26.076 mgd; firm 21.43 mgd implies ~7.1 fps ASSUMPTION scaling. Desirable 6.0 fps (p.116), Table 4-3 5.97 fps at 18 mgd (p.117).
issues.issue: 6-pump firm solution exceeds 6.0 fps desirable velocity by ~20-44%; study claims on-site main acceptable per p.117 short-segment allowance without quantifying for 21-26 mgd firm/all-pumps flows.

issues.evidence: p.107 treatment capacity = meet regulatory requirements; p.111 basin rated 12 mgd, demonstrated 11.5 mgd warm low-turbidity only, 3.5-5.0 mgd cold high-turbidity; filter areas/loading (gpm/sf), overflow rate, weir loading, CT/Section 3 withheld per RFI; p.115 57 min at 18 mgd vs ~60-min desirable.
issues.issue: Freeboard margins (0.49 ft EXIST, 0.53 ft 2-basin at 18 mgd to wall 467.5 ft dwg p.136) used to claim hydraulic fit, but treatment compliance to lift 12 mgd rating (p.111) to 18 mgd (9.0 mgd per basin, 3.0-3.6 mgd per filter) has no geometry or regulatory basis. findings.modification: Full filter-effluent/waste reconfiguration with measurement/control sized for full filter rate - REQUIRED (meter/sample move alone REJECTED as sufficient)

responses.explanation: WITHDREW 0.49-0.53 ft wall margins as proof. ACCEPTED: HSPS-5PUMP and cost bases had no audit trail. Withdrew $3.42M/$3.22M/$129k/$40k as verified estimates; costs now ASSUMPTION ranges requiring catalogue cost_estimate logging. 5-pump intermediate withdrawn as unverified copy.

Treatment compliance (overflow rate, weir loading, filter gpm/sf N/N-1, CT at 8-10 ft band with 1 ft drop p.114, 57 vs 60 min p.115) has no geometry basis - withheld.
